purpose: Workers'-compensation modified premium: subject premium (total manual premium plus premium items subject to experience rating) times the experience modification, rounded to whole dollars per the pinned Whole Dollars - Premiums rule. Subject premium composition is the caller's responsibility -- this node does not compute manual premium from payrolls and rates and never vendors or reproduces NCCI or state rate tables. Out of scope: premium discount, expense constant, terrorism/catastrophe surcharges, state taxes, schedule rating and assigned-risk surcharge; the NCCI formula does not apply in the monopolistic state funds (Ohio, North Dakota, Washington, Wyoming) or the Puerto Rico and USVI funds. A mod of 0 or less flags and never yields a premium.
